Locking the CMS: The CMS is frozen. The files below are recorded by SHA-256 and .github/scripts/cms-locked.cjs fails
Checks on any change to one of them, on a pull request or on a push to main.
To change a locked file: set its "locked" to false in this file, in its own commit, with the reason in
the commit message. Once the change is approved, run `node .github/scripts/cms-locked.cjs --relock` to
record the new hashes and set "locked" back to true.
A red check here is not a thing to work around: it means an edit reached the frozen CMS.

js/cm-cms-case.js.what: The open case the course reads from the CMS.

js/cm-cms-upload.js.what: A drafted document filed into the case in the CMS, and the trainer's record of it.

js/cm-doc-filing.js.what: The case documents filed into the CMS, the name check relay, and the Drive backup.
